description:
**Software Engineer 3 - (Python, AI, Vulnerability Research)**

**Clearance:** TS/SCI - Polygraph required  
**Position ID:** 20-16-056-SWE3  
**Location:** Columbia, Maryland

**Description:**

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to design, develop, and integrate AI-enabled capabilities supporting computer network exploitation (CNE) and vulnerability research (VR). This role combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical knowledge of vulnerability research, program analysis, and AI-assisted research workflows. We are particularly interested in candidates with hands-on experience conducting dynamic vulnerability research in isolated sandbox environments. You will independently own complex features and subsystems, translate mission needs into technical designs, and deliver reliable software from prototype through deployment. You will develop agentic AI harnesses that connect large language models, research tools, instrumented execution environments, and backend services to support repeatable, evidence-driven analysis. Working with vulnerability researchers, AI/ML engineers, and mission stakeholders, you will make sound architectural decisions, evaluate AI-generated findings, and improve the quality and effectiveness of research workflows. This position also includes mentoring engineers and contributing to technical direction and engineering standards.

* Design, develop, and maintain AI-enabled software and research tooling supporting CNE and vulnerability research workflows.
* Own the design and delivery of complex features and subsystems, including requirements refinement, implementation, testing, deployment, and sustainment.
* Develop and integrate agentic AI harnesses that orchestrate research tools, manage execution state, collect evidence, and evaluate results.
* Build and extend sandbox-based dynamic analysis capabilities for executing and observing software, capturing runtime behavior, and reproducing suspected vulnerabilities.
* Integrate debugging, instrumentation, fuzzing, crash analysis, and related research tools into automated or researcher-directed workflows.
* Establish repeatable evaluations that measure finding validity, reproducibility, false-positive rates, and the usefulness of AI-assisted analysis.
* Develop backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and user interfaces that make research capabilities accessible and results traceable.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across application code, AI integrations, research tooling, and execution environments; improve performance, reliability, and observability.
* Lead design and code reviews within assigned areas, document technical decisions, mentor engineers, and communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs to stakeholders.

**Position Required Skills:**

* Demonstrated experience independently designing, implementing, testing, and delivering complex software features or subsystems, with sound judgment about architecture, maintainability, and operational requirements.
* Proficiency in Python and experience building maintainable, tested software using modular design and appropriate object-oriented programming practices.
* Demonstrated expertise in AI-enabled CNE or vulnerability research, including integrating AI capabilities into research workflows and critically evaluating their outputs.
* Experience with vulnerability research or software analysis techniques, such as reverse engineering, debugging, dynamic analysis, fuzzing, or crash triage.
* Working knowledge of isolated execution environments and dynamic analysis concepts, including runtime instrumentation, execution tracing, environment reproducibility, and evidence collection.
* Experience developing LLM applications or agentic systems that use external tools, structured outputs, workflow state, error handling, and evaluation.
* Experience developing backend services and REST APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django, and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Experience working in Linux environments, with an understanding of operating system behavior, processes, memory, and networking relevant to software analysis.
* Experience using Git, automated testing, CI/CD, and code review to deliver reliable software collaboratively.
* Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into actionable technical work, explain technical tradeoffs, and provide effective guidance to other engineers.

**Nice to Haves**

* Strongly preferred: Hands-on experience conducting dynamic vulnerability research in sandbox environments, including configuring instrumented targets, controlling execution, capturing runtime evidence, and reproducing findings across clean environment resets.
* Experience building AI agents that interact with debuggers, fuzzers, emulators, or other analysis tools within controlled research environments.
* Experience with virtualization, emulation, snapshots, and automated provisioning of repeatable analysis environments.
* Experience with C/C++, assembly, binary analysis, memory corruption analysis, or operating system internals.
* Experience designing evaluation datasets and benchmarks for AI-assisted vulnerability discovery, triage, or validation.
* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, or search platforms such as Elasticsearch, Qdrant, or ChromaDB.
* Experience building researcher-facing interfaces using TypeScript, React, or comparable technologies.
* Contributions to vulnerability research, security tooling, open-source projects, or relevant technical publications.

**SWE3 Qualifications:**

A minimum of twelve (12) years of experience as a SWE in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity is required. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related discipline from an accredited college or university is required. Four (4) years of additional SWE experience on projects with similar software processes may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.

**Salary Range:** *$241k-$295k (Annually)*

**Realm-X** is AppFolio's AI-native platform powering this transformation. At its core, Realm-X is built on a **structured domain ontology and a set of shared business primitives**—such as transactions, actions, reports, metrics, and skills—that enable AI systems to deeply understand and operate across the full context of property management workflows. This foundation allows us to build **context-aware, action-oriented AI systems** that go beyond simple assistance to power real automation and decision-making.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to design and ship the next generation of voice and conversational AI agents within Realm-X. This role helps define AppFolio's production voice and chat agent pipelines, working at the intersection of LLM agent frameworks, real-time voice technology, and streaming infrastructure.

You will work with Product, Voice channel, and ML Platform teams to translate cutting-edge agent and voice research into reliable, low-latency, multi-channel experiences that scale across our entire customer base.

* **Ship Voice & Text Agents:** Architect and ship voice and text agent pipelines that handle real-time, multi-turn customer interactions.

* **Lead a Pod:** Lead a small pod of ML and platform engineers; raise the bar on agent evaluation, observability, and incident response.
* **Define Quality:** Partner with Product and Voice channel teams to define KPIs, eval harnesses, and acceptance criteria for agent quality.
* **Optimize for Voice:** Drive selective Small Language Model (SLM) fine-tuning and inference optimization for voice latency and cost.

**Qualifications**

* You have 5+ years of experience developing and scaling web-based applications, preferably in a SaaS environment.
* You have shipped production AI agents serving real users in voice and/or text channels.
* You think in pipelines and systems, not just models.
* You move fast, deliver impact, and maintain sound engineering judgment.
* You are humble, collaborative, and low-ego, and you elevate those around you.
* You value work-life balance as a foundation for sustained high performance.

* **LLM fluency:** Strong grasp of LLM reasoning behavior, tool use, structured output, and reasoning-vs-latency trade-offs across providers.
* **Telephony & cloud:** Production experience with Twilio (or comparable telephony) and AWS.
* **Engineering:** Expert Python, async programming, and WebSockets for real-time, bidirectional streaming.

* **Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead a small team, mentor engineers, and partner credibly with Product and Design.

**Nice to Have**

* Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or related technical discipline.
* Experience fine-tuning Small Language Models for domain-specific voice applications.
* Familiarity with RAG over structured business data and tool-using agents over API surfaces.
* Prior experience in regulated or customer-facing industries with strict reliability requirements.
* Publicly verifiable work on GitHub, in open-source agent frameworks, or in community competitions.

* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across the AI stack, from model behavior to infrastructure

* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, including model training and generalization, overfitting, bias and variance, embeddings, classification and ranking metrics, and statistical significance

* Deep understanding of how large language models behave in practice, including failure modes, non-determinism, context limits, and strategies for reliable outputs

* Rigorous, experimental mindset; you form hypotheses, measure, and let data drive decisions rather than intuition about model output

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time building backend services and systems in Python

* 2+ years building and shipping LLM-powered applications or agentic systems to production

* Hands-on production experience with LangGraph (or comparable agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom orchestration)

* 5+ years designing and building RESTful APIs (experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks preferred)

* Demonstrated experience designing and running evaluations for ML or LLM systems, and using results to drive measurable quality improvements

* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), Docker, and CI/CD pipelines

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling (such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, or similar)

* Experience with fine-tuning, embedding model selection, or classical ML pipelines

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
The AI Solutions Engineer will be embedded within Mirion’s Medical business units and partners directly with manufacturing, quality, service, and business teams to identify opportunities for improvement and deliver AI-driven solutions that produce measurable operational results. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with hands-on AI expertise and thrives in fast-paced environments where business impact is the primary measure of success.
  
Reporting directly to the Chief AI & Digital Officer, this position offers direct exposure to enterprise AI strategy while providing the autonomy to build and deploy solutions that improve how the business operates.

Identify and Prioritize Business Opportunities
  

* Embed within Medical business units to develop a deep understanding of operational workflows, challenges, and priorities.
* Participate in leadership meetings, observe manufacturing operations, and collaborate closely with quality, service, engineering, and product teams.
* Identify manual, repetitive, error-prone, or inefficient processes that may benefit from automation or AI-driven improvements.
* Translate business challenges into clearly defined technical solutions and develop business cases that support prioritization and investment.

Design, Develop, and Deploy AI Solutions
  

* Design and implement AI-powered applications that address operational challenges across manufacturing, quality, service, and administrative functions.
* Develop computer vision solutions for applications such as visual inspection, defect detection, anomaly identification, and image-based quality assurance.
* Build and deploy agentic AI and large language model (LLM)-based solutions to automate workflows, enhance decision-making, and improve operational efficiency.
* Own the full product lifecycle, including solution design, prototyping, pilot implementation, production deployment, user adoption, and ongoing improvement.
* Leverage enterprise platforms, services, and standards while maintaining a rapid, solution-oriented delivery approach.

* Define success measures and monitor key performance indicators such as cycle time, throughput, quality, productivity, error reduction, and cost savings.
* Provide training, support, and change management guidance to encourage adoption and long-term success.
* Continuously evaluate deployed solutions and implement enhancements based on user feedback and business needs.

Collaborate Across the Enterprise
  

* Partner with the Chief AI & Digital Officer and the broader AI & Digital organization to align with enterprise architecture, security, governance, and technology standards.
* Share best practices, reusable solutions, and implementation patterns that can be leveraged across business units.
* Ensure solutions meet quality, validation, documentation, and regulatory requirements applicable within a medical and regulated environment.
* Collaborate effectively with Quality, Regulatory, Engineering, IT, and Operational teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience developing and deploying production software, machine learning, or AI-based solutions.
* Experience with software engineering and cloud-based application development and deployment.
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing agentic AI or LLM-based solutions using platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar frameworks.

description:
**tl;dr/Overview:**
===================

At Alleviate Health we’re building AI Agents that drastically accelerate clinical trials by autonomously communicating with patients to recruit them into trials and support them over years, pruning billions in excess spend. **Context:**
------------

Conducting a clinical trial is the most complex and broken, but also the most high‑stakes and capital intensive, problem of our era.

To bring a life-saving medicine from the lab bench to patients, pharma companies spend **tens of billions a year** for research sites to **qualify & screen hundreds of thousands of patients and then to stay in contact with those patients over years.** Approximately 80% of clinical trials are delayed due to problems with recruitment and between $600,000 and $8 million is lost for each day a trial is delayed.

This enormous, labor-intensive struggle of screening, recruitment, and retention of patients across thousands of small research sites in every single trial is the foundational bottleneck in clinical trials.

**About Alleviate:**
--------------------

At Alleviate we've built SOTA AI Agents that autonomously recruit & retain patients in trials.

Currently, our AI agents conduct over 100,000 conversations every month by:

* Intelligently screening & routing patients to the right trials.
* Collecting necessary data for the trial from patients multiple times per week.
* Answering patients’ questions perfectly and supporting them 24/7 throughout the trial - reducing costly drop-offs.
* Continuously learning from each interaction to optimize performance.

Our team worked at a small research site for months to understand the problem deeply - personally calling and speaking to patients - and then **bootstrapped to working with some of the largest clinical research organizations** in the world and conducting over a 100k conversations per month.

**Some vitals on Alleviate (Achieved without a single dollar raised):**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Hypergrowth**. We’re growing rapidly MoM (both within existing & new accounts). We’ve landed (and realized) multiple 6 figure deals. Our largest live contract has an annual value of >$350k.

* **Our market is gigantic and immensely painful.** We can’t mention their names publicly but have landed pilots with top 20 pharma(s) that will grow to $XM+/yr. Our pipeline grows organically due to customer fear of falling behind after hearing from our existing customers.

**Investors (a16z, Jack Altman…):**
-----------------------------------

We’re now backed by Andreessen Horowitz and other investors like Jack Altman (Co-Founder of Lattice), Zach Weinberg (Co-Founder of Flatiron Health, the largest Pharma tech exit of all time), Ali Rowghani (Former CFO & COO of Twitter), Trey Holterman (CEO & Co-Founder of Tennr) and many others who’ve built category defining healthcare & pharma companies.

**What you might work on:**
---------------------------

* Orchestrating a fleet of AI agents that coordinate patient recruitment across hundreds of clinical trials across North America (For now).
* Scaling language models across Voice, SMS, and email while keeping conversations consistent and personalized across all channels.

We’re going after the largest problem in one of the largest markets in the world. We already replace tens of millions in excess spend and will replace billions of dollars of excess spend while slashing the time it takes to bring life-changing medicines to the patients who desperately need them.

We’re looking for exceptional founding engineers to help us realize this ambition. If you’re an engineer that finds this goal compelling, we'd love to talk.

As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges.

**Summary**

Beazley Security has Claude and Microsoft Copilot deployed across the company. The next step is putting agents to work across every team in the business. This is our first hire dedicated to making that happen.

You’ll work with operations, sales, finance, and other non-technical teams to find manual work worth automating. You’ll build agents in Claude and Copilot Studio, get them into daily use, and measure the time they save. Early on you’ll build most of them yourself, while teaching teams to build their own.

You’ll have a big say in what we tackle first and how we build it. This is the first hire for what we plan to grow into a team, so a lot of what you set up early will stick.

Beazley Security protects client data and systems for a living, so you’ll build security and privacy into every agent from the start. You’ll help us establish safeguards to ensure that agents can go into production quickly and safely, by building upon our existing agentic security tooling and capabilities.

**Responsibilities**

* Spend time with teams across the business, watch how the work gets done, and pick the problems where an agent saves hours or removes a manual, error-prone step. Agree on what success looks like before you build.
* Turn a stream of AI ideas into a short, ranked backlog with a clear call on each: build it, help the team build it, or leave it alone.
* Estimate what each agent will cost to run, including licensing and token consumption. Use our pre-agreed guardrails so low-risk agents go live quickly, and bring in Security, IT, Legal, or Privacy when a use case needs a closer look.
* Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and supporting automation using the Claude Platform and Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Build a group of champions across the business, run hands-on build sessions and office hours, and create the templates and playbooks teams use to build their own agents safely.

* **Days 1 to 30:** Get to know Beazley Security. Sit with at least three teams, map their most painful workflows, and build your first agent yourself. Get it into real use, even if it’s small.
* **Days 31 to 60:** Two or three agents in production, each measured against a baseline of “value”. A published intake process, and your first AI champions identified.
* **Days 61 to 90:** At least one team can point to manual work that’s gone. The agent register and build playbook are live.
* **After that:** Champions build their own agents using your patterns, and your results justify the next hire onto this team.

* Executive buy-in and support. You report to our Chief Product and Technology Officer, who uses AI every day and has built several agents for internal use. Expect quick decisions and direct help when a project gets stuck.
* A first project. A business sponsor and workflow lined up before day one.
* A fast review path. Guardrails agreed with Security and Legal before you start, so low-risk agents don’t sit in a queue.

**Qualifications**

* You’ve built AI agents or automations that are in daily use, with low-code tools like Copilot Studio or with code (Python, TypeScript, and the Claude API).
* You have hands-on experience with prompt and context design, retrieval, tool use, and evaluating agent output, and you know where LLMs fail.
* You’ve integrated with REST APIs, MCP servers, connectors, and enterprise authentication.
* You’ve typically spent four or more years in a business-facing technical role such as solutions engineering, solutions consulting, business analysis, automation, or platform delivery.
* You can learn a finance or sales operations workflow from the people who run it and build something that improves it.
* You know when a use case needs a security or privacy review before it goes anywhere, and you can estimate what an agent will cost to run on Copilot credits or Claude API usage.
* You’ve run workshops or training for non-technical audiences, and you write clearly.
* You’d rather ship a small agent that works than constantly plan and iterate on a big one.

**Preferred**

You build per-customer models without leaking the very signal they're meant to detect, and you set a high bar for evaluation and grounding across the layer.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You set technical direction for the AI layer, partner closely with the evaluation engineer to make quality measurable, and turn user feedback into durable improvements.

**What makes this role different**

* Grounding is a hard requirement no fabricated or unsupported output, ever. Faithfulness is a gate, not a tuning goal
* Clear separation of concerns ML surfaces and prioritizes; generated text only states what is supported by verified data or confirmed by a human
* Per-customer intelligence models that learn each business's behavior, with strict anti-leakage discipline
* Deploys in customer clouds including managed LLMs in-VPC, so customer data never leaves their environment

  
**Requirements**  

* **Staff-level applied ML/AI experience in production.** You have shipped and owned real ML and AI systems used by customers, and you have set technical direction for others, not only built prototypes.
* **Strong classical machine learning.** Hands-on depth in time-series modeling, anomaly and outlier detection, and gradient-boosted models such as LightGBM or XGBoost, using Python, scikit-learn and pandas or Polars.
* **Modern LLM and agent patterns.** You have built retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and structured (schema-validated) output, and orchestrated them with LangGraph or a similar framework.
* **Rigor on evaluation, grounding and hallucination control.** You know how to measure whether an LLM's output is faithful to its source data, and you have built guardrails that stop unsupported statements from reaching users.
* **Discipline around data leakage and honest evaluation.** You design features, splits and validation so models are never trained or scored on information they would not have in real use.
* **Clear thinking about what ML can and cannot claim.** You can explain to non-ML colleagues where a model's output is evidence and where it is only a signal, and why that line matters when results sit next to reported financials.
* **Real software engineering.** You write tested, production-grade Python services, are comfortable with SQL against warehouses like Snowflake or PostgreSQL, and have shipped containerized software.
* **Technical leadership.** You mentor engineers and work closely with backend, data, product and evaluation colleagues to turn feedback into lasting improvements.

Nice-to-haves

* **Finance or accounting domain experience.** Familiarity with ERP, billing or FP&A data and the audit expectations around it.
* **Feature-attribution literacy.** Experience with tools like SHAP, and a clear view of where attribution explanations break down.
* **Human-in-the-loop systems.** You have designed review, confirmation or correction workflows and fed them back into models.
* **Managed LLMs inside customer clouds.** Experience running AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or Azure OpenAI inside a customer's VPC so their data never leaves their environment.
* **Sparse and zero-inflated data.** Experience modeling rare events or data that is mostly zeros.
* **Multi-deployment enterprise software.** Exposure to products shipped as multi-tenant SaaS, single-tenant SaaS and on-premises across AWS, Azure and GCP.
